item.title: Bowel of Knowledge: Take a seat. Learn something.
item.description: 450 numbered facts in nine short chapters, made for reading a page at a time. Every fact was checked against its source, and the sources are listed at the back by fact number. Clean enough for the guest bathroom. A 6 x 9 inch paperback, 158 pages. The Bowel of Knowledge from Plainfield Press, a paperback on Amazon. Free sample pages to print at the link. bathroom trivia, fun facts, trivia quiz with answers, white elephant gift, stocking stuffer.
